Hi Elena / Straitsail procurement team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To keep the activation moving on our side we need the standard procurement/security artifacts so Finance and Legal can create the vendor and issue the PO. Specifically we need: 

- Signed DPA (we've attached our DPA draft for your review)
- Link to your most recent SOC 2 report (or AICPA portal access)
- Current subprocessor list (with contact email)
- Billing / remit-to entity and invoice sample (PDF)

If you can share the SOC2 link + subprocessor CSV and confirm who will sign the DPA (procurement or legal), we can kick off vendor creation and provide a PO template. Our target for vendor activation is the week of 6/1 if we can get materials this week.
